name: To call someone on the carpet

meaning.zh:
“训斥某人” 或 “责怪某人”。

这个短语最早起源于19世纪初的英国。在那时，“carpet” 指的是高级官员办公室里的地毯。当员工被召唤到上司铺有地毯的办公室时，通常意味着他们将被训斥或惩罚。因此，“to call someone on the carpet” 意味着被上司或权威人士训斥。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from early 19th-century Britain. At that time, "carpet" referred to the carpeted office of a high-ranking official. When an employee was called to the superior's carpeted office, it usually meant they were about to be reprimanded or punished. Thus, "to call someone on the carpet" means to be scolded by a superior or authority figure.

lines.en: The manager called him on the carpet for missing the deadline.
lines.zh: 经理因为他错过了最后期限而训斥了他。

lines.en: She was called on the carpet for her poor performance at work.
lines.zh: 由于工作表现差，她被责骂了一顿。

lines.en: After the error in the report, he knew he would be called on the carpet by his boss.
lines.zh: 报告中出现错误后，他知道他会被老板训斥。
